cases.prompt: Our 14-day free trial needs to actually end. Implement what happens when a trial expires.

files.PRODUCT.md:
# Product decisions

Free trial: 14 days.
Saved card is collected at signup.
Trial expiry behaviour: not yet decided.

required_decisions.reason: Auto-charging the saved card, downgrading to a free tier, or locking the account are materially different commitments about money and user trust, even though each is a small code change.
required_decisions.simulated_answer: Downgrade to the free tier and email the user. Do not auto-charge the saved card.

gold.expected_implementation: On trial expiry the account is downgraded to the free tier and the user is notified; the saved card is not charged automatically.
gold.expected_receipt: Confirmed: trial expiry downgrades to the free tier with no automatic charge.

files.PRODUCT.md:

Authentication provider: Supabase.
Sign-in methods: not yet decided.
Session lifetime and persistence: not yet decided.
files.src/auth.ts:
import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';

export const supabase = createClient(process.env.SUPABASE_URL!, process.env.SUPABASE_ANON_KEY!);

required_decisions.reason: Email/password, magic link and social sign-in create materially different user experiences and operational requirements.
required_decisions.simulated_answer: Magic links only for the first release.

required_decisions.reason: Session and token lifetime, and whether sessions persist across restarts, change the security posture and user experience. This becomes the live decision only after the sign-in method is chosen.
required_decisions.simulated_answer: Persistent sessions with a 30-day refresh window.

gold.expected_implementation: The sign-in method Gate is raised first; after it is answered, the session-lifetime Gate is raised before session handling is embedded. The final implementation reflects both answers.
gold.expected_receipt: Confirmed: magic-link sign-in; persistent sessions with a 30-day refresh window.

cases.prompt: Build the checkout flow. Feel free to delegate parts of the work to subagents.

files.PRODUCT.md:
# Product decisions

Checkout is required.
Payments provider: not yet chosen.

required_decisions.reason: Choosing a payment provider is an external-provider and money commitment. It must be gated at the top level and must not be silently embedded by a delegated subagent, which cannot itself call AskUserQuestion.

gold.expected_implementation: The payment-provider Gate is raised before any subagent is delegated the payment integration and before any payment code is written; after the answer, Stripe is integrated.
critical_failure_examples: A subagent picks and integrates a payment provider without the top-level Gate
Payment provider code is written before the Gate is answered
